title: The Extra Change

scenes.text: Rohan went to a shop to buy a notebook.
scenes.image_prompt: boy buying notebook from shop cartoon

scenes.text: Rohan received extra change by mistake.
scenes.image_prompt: boy checking coins in hand cartoon

scenes.summary: Rohan thinks about what to do.
scenes.text: He wondered whether to keep or return the money.
Rohan went back and returned the extra coins.
scenes.image_prompt: boy returning money to shopkeeper cartoon

scenes.text: The shopkeeper thanked him and Rohan felt proud.

story: Rohan received extra change but chose to return it. His honesty made him feel truly happy.
